thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT RIV-1234 - Dedicated EU routing errors affecting RivenBank (high priority). Auto-pager triggered. See alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/RIV-1234

alice-sre: Acknowledged. I'm pulling the tails and metrics now — seeing spike in 5xx from embed-proxy -> eu-dedicated-pool around 09:07 UTC. p95 token latency up from 120ms -> 900ms.

ben-oncall: I'm oncall and paged. Joining. set status -> "investigating" on status.redwood.ai?

carla-cs: RivenBank AM is David (david@rivenbank.com) and their infra contact is ops@rivenbank.com. They have two high-priority routes: rivenbank-prod and rivenbank-embeds. They just reported "timeouts on critical webhook flows".

david-am: Confirmed — our payments reconciliation job is failing for ~10% of requests since 09:05. Please keep me updated, key contacts on standby.

alice-sre: Quick triage notes: error pattern is 502/504 from gateway, backend pods show high accept-queue and GC pauses on one node. Candidate cause: autoscaler didn't add replicas during burst.

frank-eng: We rolled a small kernel/runtime patch to the eu pool at 08:55 but rollout completed without errors. Rolling back to previous revision as mitigation candidate. Revision IDs: current=rev-9876, previous=rev-9742.

ben-oncall: Performing rollback to rev-9742 on eu-dedicated-pool now. Will report back with progress.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback started by ben-oncall: kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/eu-dedicated-proxy --to-revision=9742 (job id: dpl-8721).

alice-sre: While rollback proceeds: increasing pool capacity as emergency measure. Command: ./infra scale-dedicated --pool eu-dedicated --min 6 --max 20.

frank-eng: Noted. Adding temporary health-check smoothing to reduce thrash: set healthProbe.failureThreshold=10 for proxy.

carla-cs: Draft notification to RivenBank for review: "Hi David — we're investigating increased errors for your Dedicated EU endpoints impacting reconciliation jobs. We're rolling back a recent runtime change and scaling capacity to mitigate. We'll follow up in 15 minutes with status. —Redwood Support" Should I send?

david-am: Yes please send that. Add that you have a targeted mitigation in progress and ETA ~15-20m.

ben-oncall: Rollback finished: rev-9742 is active. Early signs: 5xx rate dropping. Continuing to monitor.

ops-bot: Autoscaler snapshots: cpu_util 85% -> now 62%; replica_count increased from 3 -> 8 (manual scale).

alice-sre: Monitoring logs: the node that had GC pauses is healthy now after rollback. KV cache fill remains normal. Latency p95 back to ~180ms for most traffic, rivenbank routes to 220ms.

carla-cs: Sending tailored customer message now (via email thread):
carla-cs: "Hi David / RivenBank team — We mitigated a runtime regression affecting Dedicated EU routing and scaled your pool to restore throughput. You may see a reduction in errors; please let us know if anything persists. Our triage is ongoing and we'll share a full summary soon. —Carla, Redwood Support"

david-am: Got it, thanks Carla. We see success rate improving on our end — reconciliation failures dropped to ~1%.

emily-product: Draft status page update (short):

emily-product: "Investigating — We are responding to increased 5xx errors impacting some Dedicated EU customers. Mitigation (rollback + capacity increase) is in progress. Some customers may experience temporary errors. Updates every 15 minutes."

ben-oncall: Can we include a short tailored blurb for RivenBank on the status page private feed?

alice-sre: Suggested private status snippet for RivenBank: "RivenBank: Partial request errors observed on Dedicated EU routes (rivenbank-prod / rivenbank-embeds). Mitigation applied (runtime rollback + scaling). Impact reduced, continued monitoring. Dedicated contact: david@rivenbank.com."

carla-cs: OK to post private snippet. I'll also open a high-priority support ticket and attach logs.

ops-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-5421 (linked to incident RIV-1234).

frank-eng: Follow-up action items while this is fresh: 1) Full revert validation (frank-eng), 2) Autoscaler thresholds audit + fix (alice-sre), 3) Customer post-incident write-up + tailored timeline (carla-cs/david-am). Assigning owners.

alice-sre: Quick root-cause hypothesis: recent runtime change reduced tail-latency under normal load but made the autoscaler misread healthy signals during bursts leading to delayed scaling. We'll capture histograms and confirm.

ben-oncall: Status update to channel: impact reduced; rolling monitoring for next 45m. If stable, we'll update status page to "identified" then "resolved" once confirmed for 2 hours.

carla-cs: Sent direct email to RivenBank with mitigation summary and support ticket link. They acknowledged and asked for post-mortem and compensation guidance.

emily-product: For status page public copy (if asked): "Resolved — A runtime regression temporarily affected Dedicated EU routing causing increased 5xx responses for some customers. We rolled back the change and scaled capacity; normal service has been restored. A detailed incident report will be posted to customers impacted within 48 hours." (post after 2h stable).

ops-bot: Metric alert cleared: eu-dedicated-5xx-rate returned to baseline.

alice-sre: Final note before handoff: keep incident open for postmortem. Handing to Frank for deeper autoscaler analysis and to Carla for customer comms.

frank-eng: Picking up RCA. Will collect flamegraphs, autoscaler logs, and rollout traces. Target: preliminary RCA doc in 24 hours.

carla-cs: I'll prepare the tailored customer impact statement for RivenBank including timeline, mitigation, and next steps. Draft snippet for customer post-incident: "Impact: Between 09:05–09:42 UTC we observed elevated errors affecting reconciliation and webhook flows for RivenBank on Dedicated EU. Mitigation: rollback of runtime change at 09:15 UTC and manual scaling at 09:17 UTC restored normal throughput. Current status: service stable — rate of failed requests reduced to <1%. Next steps: detailed RCA and remediation plan within 48 hours."

ben-oncall: Closing notes: oncall remains available for escalation. Closing incident in-channel at 11:00 UTC if metrics stable.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RIV-1234 status changed -> monitoring.

carla-cs: Postmortem owners: frank-eng (RCA), alice-sre (autoscaler fix), carla-cs (customer comm). Will schedule a 30m sync tomorrow with RivenBank if they want a walkthrough.

frank-eng: Quick grep of autoscaler config shows threshold=65% cpu for scale-up, scale-down=40%, cooldown=300s. We'll evaluate reducing cooldown and adding burst detection.

alice-sre: Adding follow-up ticket: INFRA-2015 autoscaler cooldown tuning + rollback gating for runtime releases.

carla-cs: RivenBank replied: "Appreciate the rapid response. Please include any mitigations to prevent recurrence and timeline for the RCA."

ben-oncall: Thanks team. I'll archive logs and mark incident ticket SUP-5421 with initial mitigation notes.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RIV-1234 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring.

carla-cs: Final: I'll send official resolved notice once we hit the 2-hour stable window.

frank-eng: Posting preliminary log snippets to SUP-5421 and internal RCA doc (link: https://docs.internal/riv-1234-rca).

alice-sre: Handing off to postmortem lane. Closing realtime thread.

ben-oncall: Thanks all.
